name: My Dog Girlfriend
source: You’re about to start your new life as a cafe owner when a few suspicious boxes show up at your door. Inside you find two dog girls that have come back to find you after you’d left them to start a new life! In this world, pets are known to take on a human form as time goes by! You can’t resist how adorable they are and decide to work together with them on making your cafe the best in town! An expert dog girl decides to join your team and just when you think things are going great, a shadow from your past comes back to haunt you… Will you be able to overcome the challenge and become the best cafe owner in town? Will one of the dog girls end up being your true love…? It’s all up to you!
translation: 你正準備以咖啡館老闆的身分展開新生活，門口卻突然出現了幾個可疑的箱子。打開一看，裡面竟是兩位犬耳少女！原來，她們就是你為了開始新生活而留下的兩隻狗，如今又回來找你了！在這個世界，寵物會隨著時間流逝化為人形，這是人盡皆知的事。你實在抵擋不住她們的可愛，便決定與她們一起，把咖啡館打造成鎮上最棒的一家！一位經驗豐富的犬耳少女也決定加入團隊。可就在你以為一切都進展順利時，過去的陰影再次找上門來……你能否克服挑戰，成為鎮上最出色的咖啡館老闆？其中一位犬耳少女，又會不會成為你的真愛……？一切都由你決定！
